p|panel|pd_no_cortable: Only an antivirus can be blocked as a whole (a browser or a program would stop working); their destinations can be blocked one by one.
p|panel|pd_pais_nada: Your watched programs have not talked to servers in this country.
p|panel|pd_dns_tarda: If the program already had the address, it may take a few minutes to stop connecting.
p|panel|pd_hecho_cortar_prog: {prog}: everything it sends, blocked in the Windows firewall.
p|panel|pd_aviso_cortar_prog: You are about to block everything {prog} sends. Without updates or cloud analysis it will protect less. Another click undoes it, and if GUARDIANA stops, Windows lifts it by itself.
p|panel|pd_confirmar: This name looks necessary for the system. Block it anyway?
p|panel|pd_maxima_on: Done: everything the antivirus sends is blocked. While it lasts, it gets no updates.
p|panel|pd_maxima_off: Block removed: the antivirus connects and gets updates again.
p|panel|pd_boton_portada: See how GUARDIANA works inside your computer
p|panel|pd_portada_texto: Live, on the globe: what your antivirus, your browser and your programs send to each country and each company, and what GUARDIANA blocks.
p|panel|pd_cortado_ancho: Stopped: a general GUARDIANA rule (by category) does not let this name out
p|panel|pd_ancho_dejar: A general rule stops it; to let it through, use “Allow” on its row in the Snapshot.
p|panel|pd_sin_antivirus: No traffic from any known antivirus in this window.
p|panel|pd_vigilancia_off_corto: Watching is off: what the antivirus sends is not measured (turn it on in “Your antivirus”).
p|panel|pd_doc_matiz: Explained does not mean harmless (telemetry is explained too); unexplained does not mean bad.
p|panel|pd_lugar_zona: Approximate visual reference taken from the time zone. A time zone does not confirm the country or city.
p|panel|pd_lugar_pais: Approximate visual reference for the country. Select “Pinpoint” or confirm your city to place the computer correctly.
p|panel|pd_grabar_que: Saves what GUARDIANA measures for five minutes, every 10 seconds, and gives it to you as PDF, CSV and JSON. It does not record video or the screen.
p|panel|pd_clic_info: Click: all the information and what to do
p|panel|pd_pos_pais: On the map: inside {pais}. GUARDIANA knows the server's country, not the city; the points of one country are spread around its center so each can be seen.
p|panel|pd_btn_cortar: Block this name on this computer
p|panel|pd_cortado_por_maxima: It is blocked because «Block everything the antivirus sends» is on. For this name to get through, that whole block has to be removed.
p|panel|pd_cortado_por_categoria: It is stopped by a general rule of yours («{cat}»). Remove it under Rules for this name to pass.
p|panel|pd_ver_pais_extracto: Everything that went to {pais}, in the Ledger
p|panel|pd_ver_antivirus: Your antivirus: terms, official decisions and blocks
p|panel|pd_av_para_que: What for, according to its maker
p|panel|pd_av_sin_doc: Purpose not published by the maker
p|panel|pd_av_5min_nada: It has sent nothing in these 5 minutes.
p|panel|pd_av_defender_wu: Microsoft Defender downloads its signatures through Windows Update, under another Windows process: that does not show under its name here.
p|panel|pd_ex_sub: Last 24 hours · measured on this computer · updated every 5 seconds
p|panel|pd_ex_buscar: Search a program, a name or a company
p|panel|pd_ex_sin_destinos: No destinations measured in the window.
p|panel|pd_ex_nada: No program has sent anything yet in this window.
p|panel|pd_lugar_region: It is region {region} of {op}, according to the address list the operator itself publishes. Where the data is kept afterwards inside the company cannot be seen from your computer.
p|panel|pd_lugar_base: It is the city the address database gives for that address. It is approximate: the operator of the server does not declare it, and it does not say which building the data ends up in.
p|panel|pd_lugar_geofeed: It is the city {op} declares for that address in its public list (geofeed). Where the data is kept afterwards cannot be seen from your computer.
p|panel|pd_precisar_que: Requests several fresh readings from the device, keeps the most accurate one and shows its margin of error. It stays in this browser: GUARDIANA sends it to no one.
p|panel|pd_precisar_pide: Measuring the device location. This can take a few seconds while it looks for a more accurate reading.
p|panel|pd_precisar_hecho: Location measured: {lugar}. Accuracy reported by the device: ±{precision}.
p|panel|pd_precisar_denegado: Location permission was not given. You can allow it from the padlock in the address bar or confirm your city.
p|panel|pd_precisar_fallo: The device could not measure its location. You can confirm your city to place it correctly.
p|panel|pd_precisar_no: This browser does not offer the computer's location.
p|panel|pd_precisar_impreciso: The reading only narrows the area to ±{km} km, so GUARDIANA will not use it as an exact city.
p|panel|pd_lugar_equipo: Location measured by the device (reported margin: ±{precision}) and rounded for privacy. It is only stored in this browser.
p|panel|pd_lugar_manual: City confirmed by the person. It is only stored in this browser.
p|panel|pd_corregir_texto: If Windows or the location service is wrong, search for your city. Your choice stays in this browser.
p|panel|pd_corregir_sin_resultados: No city with that name was found.
p|panel|pd_vpn_explica: While the VPN is on, anything measured through the network (and your way out to the internet) is where the VPN is, not where you are. To place yourself right, press “Pinpoint” (GPS or Wi-Fi, not the network) or “Correct city”.
p|panel|pd_vpn_aviso: You are leaving through a VPN ({n}): your computer is placed by its time zone, not by the network. If that is not your city, correct it.
p|panel|pd_vpn_medida: The measurement came through the network, and with the VPN ({n}) on that places the VPN’s exit, not your computer. It is not used. Choose your city or measure with GPS or Wi-Fi.
p|panel|pd_av_dentro_midiendo: Measuring: the first figure arrives with the next reading (5 seconds).
p|panel|pd_av_dentro_nota: Windows counters (the same as Task Manager), every 5 seconds while this page is open. “Reads and writes” is everything the program asks for, to files and other devices: it does not say which files. An antivirus has to read to protect you.
p|panel|rv_intro: What Windows says about this computer: whether it is protected, who can get in, what starts on its own, where your internet goes out and what it knows about you. GUARDIANA only reads: it changes nothing and installs nothing. Anything that appears after the first check-up is marked “new”.
p|panel|rv_copiado: Copied: paste it wherever you want to share it.
p|panel|rv_no_copiado: This browser does not allow copying; use “Save PDF”.
p|panel|rv_pie: How it works: GUARDIANA asks Windows with its own tools (registry, event logs, Windows Security). To test your DNS it asks three questions about public names (dns.google, one.one.one.one and a made-up name) to the DNS servers the computer uses; nothing else goes out. Only the list of names seen is kept, to know what is new; no address.
p|panel|vg_intro: GUARDIANA keeps watching, and only watching, what the system itself records: which program uses the camera or the microphone, what starts launching on its own, whether a privacy setting changes and whether the antivirus or the firewall is switched off. It changes nothing, reads the content of nothing, and none of this leaves your computer.
p|panel|vg_esperando: The first check arrives in a few seconds.
p|panel|vg_ritmo: camera and microphone every {r} s, the rest every {l} min
p|panel|vg_historial_vacio: Nothing to tell yet. That is good news too.
p|panel|vg_cadena_ok_titulo: Each line carries the fingerprint of the one before it, and the whole chain was checked just now.
p|panel|vg_cadena_rota: The history does not add up from line {x}
p|panel|vg_pie: Read only. GUARDIANA asks the system what it records itself (the Windows registry, Windows Security, the tasks and the services) and compares it with the previous time. What it finds stays in a chained history on this computer, erased with «Delete everything».
p|panel|vg_no_sistema: Not available on this system yet.
p|panel|vg_error: The system did not answer at the last check: {x}
p|panel|vg_check_arranque: Programs that start on their own
p|panel|vg_cm_nadie: No other program is using the camera or the microphone now.
p|panel|vg_cm_limite: This is what Windows records. Some desktop programs may not be identified if they reach the device without going through Windows' permission.
p|panel|vigia_lead: While you talk or chat through GUARDIANA, the watch checks every few seconds whether another program is using the microphone, the camera or the screen, whether someone can see or control this computer remotely, and whether the antivirus is protecting it. If it sees something, the communication stops and says what it was.
p|panel|vigia_excluido: {x} does not count: it is the browser you are viewing this page from.
p|panel|vg_cm_motor_web: web engine: may be GUARDIANA ZERO or another program
p|panel|vg_ar_ok: {total} things start on their own. Nothing new in the last 24 hours.
p|panel|vg_ar_nuevos: {n} new in the last 24 hours, out of {total} that start on their own.
p|panel|vg_ar_desde: Starting point: {f}. Anything that appears later shows here with the time it was seen.
p|panel|vg_pr_ok: {n} settings recorded. It tells you if any of them changes.
p|panel|vg_pr_cambios: A setting changed in the last 24 hours ({cambios} changes in 7 days).
p|panel|vg_pt_atencion: Part of the protection is off.
p|panel|vg_pt_segundo_plano: standing aside: another antivirus is in charge
p|panel|vg_pt_mac: On a Mac the firewall is watched; the system's antivirus (XProtect) has no switch to read.
p|panel|vg_atencion_tiempo_real: Microsoft Defender's real-time protection is off. You can turn it back on in Windows Security.
p|panel|vg_atencion_sin_antivirus: No antivirus has its protection on.
p|panel|vg_atencion_cortafuegos: The firewall is off in the {x} profile.
p|panel|vg_ev_uso_al_empezar: {programa} was already using {recurso} when the watch started
p|panel|vg_ev_arranque_base: Starting point: {n} things that start on their own recorded
p|panel|vg_ev_arranque_nuevo: New program that starts on its own: {x} ({tipo}, since {cuando})
p|panel|vg_ev_arranque_varios: {n} new programs that start on their own at once (an installation)
p|panel|vg_ev_arranque_ido: No longer starts on its own: {x}
p|panel|vg_ev_privacidad_cambio: A privacy setting changed: {ajuste}{cuenta}, from «{antes}» to «{despues}»
p|panel|vg_ev_exclusion_nueva: Microsoft Defender has a new exclusion and no longer scans: {que}
p|panel|vg_ev_exclusion_ya: Microsoft Defender already had an exclusion when the watch started: {que}
p|panel|vg_ev_exclusion_quitada: Microsoft Defender removed an exclusion and scans again: {que}
p|panel|vg_ev_vaciado_seguridad: Windows' Security event log was cleared
p|panel|vg_ev_vaciado_otro: A Windows event log was cleared
p|panel|vg_ev_tiempo_real_apagado: Microsoft Defender's real-time protection was turned off
p|panel|vg_ev_tiempo_real_ya: Microsoft Defender's real-time protection was already off when the watch started
p|panel|vg_ev_tiempo_real_vuelve: Microsoft Defender's real-time protection is back on
p|panel|vg_ev_sin_antivirus: No antivirus has its protection on any more
p|panel|vg_ev_sin_antivirus_ya: No antivirus had its protection on when the watch started
p|panel|vg_ev_sin_antivirus_vuelve: An antivirus has its protection on again
p|panel|vg_ev_cortafuegos_apagado: The firewall was turned off ({x} profile)
p|panel|vg_ev_cortafuegos_ya: The firewall was already off when the watch started ({x} profile)
p|panel|vg_ev_cortafuegos_vuelve: The firewall is back on ({x} profile)
p|panel|rv_conclusion_alerta: The check-up found {alerta} problems to fix and {aviso} things worth checking. Start with the ones marked in red.
p|panel|rv_conclusion_aviso: Nothing serious. There are {aviso} things worth checking; the rest is fine or just for your information.
p|panel|rv_conclusion_ok: Everything checked is fine: nothing serious and nothing to check. Open the informational items if you want to know your computer better.
p|panel|rv_revisando: Checking… Windows takes between 20 seconds and a couple of minutes.
p|panel|rv_aun_no: No check-up yet. Press «Check now» to start.
p|panel|rv_no_windows: For now the computer check-up is Windows only.
